The '''DecipherCon 1999 website''' was the part of [[Decipher]]'s site that covered [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). It sat under <code>/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/</code> on decipher.com. Before the convention it took registrations and posted the schedule; during and after it, it carried results, reports, photos and audio.<ref name="idx">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/index.html DecipherCon 1999], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128065643/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> Its home page was still online in December 2002.<ref name="idx2002">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ DecipherCon 1999 (2002 copy)], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020823212712/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/ Internet Archive]</ref> [[DecipherCon website]] covers all three DecipherCon sites; the photos and other images are on [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

[[File:DecipherCon 1999 website home page.png|thumb|Home page after the convention, November 1999.]]

== Home page ==
The home page opened "Welcome to DecipherCon 1999!" and said "DecipherCon is over. We've kept the best of our coverage for all of you!" A box headed "Notes from Lalumiere..." linked the four daily wrap-ups. A second column linked "they picked the winners", decks, audio feeds, event reports, photos, the event schedule and results, special guests, and the three World Championship pages.<ref name="idx" />

== Before the convention ==
* '''Register online''': pre-registration until 31 October 1999, with or without a Cavalier Hotel room.<ref name="reg">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/register.html DecipherCon 1999: Registration], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128100221/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/register.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Prize details''': the prizes Decipher planned to give out, and panels and clinics with Product Development.<ref name="prizes">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/prizes.html DecipherCon 1999: Prizes], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128083925/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/prizes.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Special guests''': Chase Masterson ("Leeta"), [[Aron Eisenberg]] ("Nog") and [[Jeremy Bulloch]] ("Boba Fett").<ref name="sg99">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests.html DecipherCon 1999: Special guests], Decipher (1999). * '''Event schedule''': a draft schedule by day, with a page for each day.<ref name="ev">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events.html DecipherCon 1999: Event schedule], Decipher (1999). More than 900 votes were cast for Star Wars CCG and 500 for Star Trek CCG.<ref name="vote">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/vote.html DecipherCon 1999: Vote for the champ], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000120055420/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/vote.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Results are on [[1999 Decipher World Championship]].

The guest schedule page gave signing times for the guests, named Decipher staff who would attend, and showed the Austin Powers Corvette.<ref name="sgi">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html DecipherCon 1999: Special guests schedule], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Shannon Baksa]] had her own page as Mara Jade.<ref name="shannon">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/shannonbio.html Shannon Baksa biography], Decipher (1999).
